dex_boosts.description: DexScreener token boosts (paid promotion signal) — "latest" or "top".

dex_ohlcv.description: OHLCV candles for one GeckoTerminal pool.

before_timestamp.description: Unix seconds; return candles before this time (0 = latest).

network.description: Chain name or alias (solana, eth, bsc, base, arbitrum...).

pool.description: Pool address (the GeckoTerminal pool/pair id for that network).

resolution.description:
"<timeframe>" or "<timeframe>:<aggregate>" — timeframe is
minute/hour/day; aggregates minute 1/5/15, hour 1/4/12, day 1.
Examples: "hour", "hour:4", "minute:15".

dex_pairs.description: Look up one DexScreener pair by chain and pair address.

chain.description: Chain name or alias (solana, eth, bsc, base, arbitrum, polygon...).

dex_pools.description: GeckoTerminal pools: all pools on a network, one token's pools, or a search.

network.description: Chain name or alias (solana, eth, bsc, base, arbitrum...).

query.description: Free-text pool search (used only when token is empty).

token.description: Token address — returns that token's pools (takes precedence).

dex_search.description: Search DexScreener for pairs by token symbol, name, or pair address.

dex_token.description: All DexScreener pairs for one or more token addresses (comma-separated, max 30).

evm_blockNumber.description: Get current block number for an EVM chain.

evm_call.description: Execute a read-only contract call (eth_call). Chain: ethereum, base, arbitrum.

evm_getBalance.description: Get ETH/native token balance for an address in wei.

evm_getBlock.description: Get EVM block by number or 'latest'. Chain: ethereum, base, arbitrum.

evm_getLogs.description: Get event logs for an EVM contract address.

evm_getTransaction.description: Get EVM transaction by hash. Chain: ethereum, base, arbitrum.

evm_getTransactionReceipt.description: Get EVM transaction receipt (logs, gas used, status).

evm_health.description: Health check for EVM RPC endpoints. Chain: ethereum, base, or arbitrum.

intel_archive_schema.description: Discover the schema and available data in the Hugging Face Hub archives. Lists all chains, networks, and file counts.

intel_duckdb_query.description: Execute a raw DuckDB query against the remote HF Hub archives. Use httpfs to read Parquet/JSONL files over HTTPS without downloading.

intel_entity_search.description: Search entity profiles in the local Postgres database. Find wallets by entity name, label tag, or type.

intel_wallet_profile.description:
Comprehensive cross-chain wallet intelligence profile.
Queries live RPCs (Solana + all EVM chains) + Postgres entity tags + DuckDB historical archives.
This is the primary intelligence tool — combines live data with historical patterns and entity labels.

sol_getAccountInfo.description: Solana account info: lamports, owner, executable, data.

sol_getBalance.description: SOL balance in lamports for an address.

sol_getBlock.description: Solana block details by slot (transactions, blockhash, time).

sol_getEpochInfo.description: Current Solana epoch info: epoch, slot index, absolute slot, block height.

sol_getMultipleAccounts.description: Batch account info for up to 100 Solana addresses.

sol_getProgramAccounts.description: All accounts owned by a Solana program.

sol_getRecentBlockhash.description: Recent Solana blockhash for transaction building.

sol_getSignaturesForAddress.description: Recent transaction signatures for a Solana address.

sol_getTokenAccounts.description: All SPL token accounts owned by an address (mint, amount, decimals).

sol_getTokenLargestAccounts.description: Top 20 token holders for a mint address.

sol_getTokenSupply.description: Total supply of an SPL token by mint address.

sol_getTransaction.description: Full Solana transaction details by signature (parsed instructions, accounts, logs).

sol_health.description: Health check — all Solana RPC endpoints, active endpoint, latencies.

web_scrape.description:
Scrape any webpage via the self-hosted Pry engine and return clean,
LLM-ready markdown or JSON. Adaptive 12-tier anti-bot escalation handles
Cloudflare/DataDome/Akamai automatically when bypass_cloudflare is set.

formats.description: Output formats, e.g. ["markdown"] or ["json"]. Defaults to markdown.

js_render.description: Allow browser-tier rendering for JS-heavy pages (default true).

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to scrape.

xchain_health.description: Health check for ALL chains (Solana + all EVM). Returns per-chain status.

xchain_profile.description: Cross-chain wallet profile. Queries Solana + Ethereum + Base + Arbitrum for the SAME address pattern.
